messages:
lindsey: Hey team — accepted the org invite this morning but when I go to https://github.com/redwood-inference I see zero repos and a banner that says 'You don't have access to any repositories yet'. I accepted via my work email (lindsey@redwood.ai). Tried logging out/in and incognito. Any tips?

onboarding-bot: Hi @lindsey :wave: If you accepted an SSO org invite, you'll need to confirm SSO access by clicking the 'Authorize' button on the organization page or via the email invite link. Also make sure your GitHub account email matches your work email.

lindsey: I clicked 'Authorize' from the org page and it shows SSO set to 'required' for the org. It then redirects to the company SSO and says 'You're already authenticated' but still no repos.

alex: @lindsey can you share your GitHub username? I'll check your org role and team memberships. Also did you add an SSH key or try cloning via HTTPS?

lindsey: username is linds-ay. I tried `gh auth login` then `gh repo clone redwood-inference/console` and got: `ERROR: repository not found or you do not have permission to access it`.

jamie: SSO note: org requires 2FA at the account level. If your GitHub account doesn't have 2FA enabled, the SSO authorization can appear to succeed but won't grant repo access. Go to Settings -> Security -> Enable two-factor authentication.

lindsey: oh — I enabled 2FA just now (authenticator app). Confirmed on my profile it shows 2FA enabled.

alex: Thanks. I see an invited member record for `linds-ay` but you were never added to any teams. I can add you to the `engineers` team which has access to most repos. Want me to add you?

lindsey: Yes please. My first-week checklist says I need access to `docs`, `console`, and `infra-config`.

ben-oncall: Quick note — infra repos are restricted: they grant read to engineers, write to `platform` team. If you need push access to `infra-config` ping infra owner.

mike-sre: added `linds-ay` to team: engineers and to `docs-contributors`. You may need to sign out and sign back in or trigger SSO again to pick up team membership.

lindsey: reloaded and can now see repos, yay :tada: Thanks! One follow-up: I still can't push to `infra/infra-config` — permissions denied.

alex: For infra push access we need a quick approval from @ben-oncall or @mike-sre. For now I'll add you to `infra-reviewers` with triage perms so you can open PRs. If you need direct push, file a request in #eng-infra with repo and justification.

lindsey: sounds good. For visibility — steps that fixed it: 1) enable 2FA on GitHub 2) accept SSO/authorize on org page 3) wait ~2min and re-login. Posting here in case future new-hires hit same issue.

onboarding-bot: Thanks @lindsey — adding this to the onboarding doc: "If you accept the org invite but see no repos: enable account-level 2FA, authorize SSO on the org page, then re-login."

lindsey: thanks all! One last Q: where do I request access to `infra/infra-config` for push? Should I open a ticket somewhere?

ben-oncall: create a ticket in our internal access tracker (https://internal.redwood.ai/access) with repo path and reason; tag `infra` and `security`. Typical turnaround is same day for devs.

lindsey: filed the ticket, number ACC-4123. marking resolved here. :)

alex: welcome aboard @lindsey — ping me if you want a tour of the console codebase later this week.
